cards.card_text: Isaiah the prophet has a message for Israel, and it opens on Bel and Nebo, gods of Babylon.
Bel and Nebo's idols are a heavy load.
Babylon's false gods get named in the announcement too: Bel and Marduk.
cards.verse_text: “Announce and declare to the nations; lift up a banner and proclaim it; hold nothing back when you say, ‘Babylon is captured; Bel is put to shame; Marduk is shattered, her images are disgraced, her idols are broken in pieces.’

cards.card_text: The announcement says Bel is put to shame and Marduk is shattered.

cards.card_text: Last, the LORD says He'll punish Bel, a false god of Babylon, and make him spew out what he swallowed.
cards.verse_text: I will punish Bel in Babylon.
